lines.text: Ephraim surrounds the LORD with lies and makes a covenant with Assyria, and he sends olive oil to Egypt.
In the womb Jacob grasped his brother's heel, and as a grown man he wrestled with God and found Him at Bethel.
The LORD calls them to return to their God, and Ephraim boasts that he has become rich.
The LORD says He will again make them dwell in palaces, and He warns that altars in Gilgal will become heaps of stones.
Jacob fled to the land of Aram and tended sheep for a wife, and by a king the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt.
